title: Dissecting the Effect of ALS Mutation G335D on the Early Aggregation of the TDP-43 Amyloidogenic Core Peptide: Helix-to-beta-Sheet Transition and Conformational Shift.
authors: Li, Fangying; Chen, Yujie; Tang, Yiming; Liu, Xianshi; Wei, Guanghong
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD和REST2模拟研究ALS突变G335D对TDP-43淀粉样核心肽段二聚化和构象转变的影响，虽涉及蛋白构象模拟，但对象为蛋白自身聚集而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无直接关联。
abstract: The aggregation of TAR DNA-binding protein of 43 kDa (TDP-43) into fibrillary deposits is associated with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). The 311-360 fragment of TDP-43 (TDP-43(311-360)), the amyloidogenic core region, can spontaneously aggregate into fibrils, and the ALS-associated mutation G335D has an enhanced effect on TDP-43(311-360) fibrillization. However, the molecular mechanism underlying G335D-enhanced aggregation at atomic level remains largely unknown. By utilizing all-atom molecular dynamics (MD) and replica exchange with solute tempering 2 (REST2) simulations, we investigated influences of G335D on the dimerization (the first step of aggregation) and conformational ensemble of the TDP-43(311-360) peptide. Our simulations show that G335D mutation increases inter-peptide interactions, especially inter-peptide hydrogen-bonding interactions in which the mutant site has a relatively large contribution, and enhances the dimerization of TDP-43(311-360) peptides. The alpha-helix regions in the NMR-resolved conformation of the TDP-43(311-360) monomer (321-330 and 335-343) play an essential role in the formation of the dimer. G335D mutation induces helix unfolding and promotes alpha-to-beta conversion. G335D mutation alters the conformational distribution of TDP-43(311-360) dimers and causes population shift from helix-rich to beta-sheet-rich conformations, which facilitates the fibrillization of the TDP-43(311-360) peptide. Our MD and REST2 simulation results suggest that the 321-330 region is of paramount importance to alpha-to-beta transition and could be the initiation site for TDP-43(311-360) fibrillization. Our work reveals the mechanism underlying the enhanced aggregation propensity of the G335D TDP-43(311-360) peptide, which provides atomistic insights into the G335D mutation-caused pathogenicity of TDP-43 protein.
abstract_zh: TAR DNA结合蛋白43 kDa（TDP-43）聚集成纤维状沉积物与肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）相关。TDP-43的311-360片段（TDP-43(311-360)）作为淀粉样生成核心区域，能自发聚集成纤维，且ALS相关突变G335D对TDP-43(311-360)的纤维化具有增强作用。然而，G335D增强聚集在原子水平上的分子机制仍 largely unknown。通过利用全原子分子动力学 (molecular dynamics, MD) 和溶质回火复制交换2 (replica exchange with solute tempering 2, REST2) 模拟，我们研究了G335D对TDP-43(311-360)肽二聚化（聚集的第一步）及构象集合的影响。我们的模拟显示，G335D突变增加了肽间相互作用，尤其是突变位点贡献较大的肽间氢键相互作用，并增强了TDP-43(311-360)肽的二聚化。NMR解析的TDP-43(311-360)单体构象中的α-螺旋区域（321-330和335-343）在二聚体形成中起关键作用。G335D突变诱导螺旋解折叠并促进α到β的转换。G335D突变改变了TDP-43(311-360)二聚体的构象分布，并导致从富螺旋构象向富β折叠构象的群体转移，从而促进TDP-43(311-360)肽的纤维化。我们的MD和REST2模拟结果表明，321-330区域对α到β转变至关重要，可能是TDP-43(311-360)纤维化的起始位点。我们的工作揭示了G335D TDP-43(311-360)肽增强聚集倾向的机制，为G335D突变引起的TDP-43蛋白致病性提供了原子层面的见解。
